text:
laura: Quick bug report — the onboarding sampleapp (auth-flow) retries on 401 and never surfaces a typed AuthError, so users see an endless spinner.
sam: ugh, seen that. Is the retry loop coming from the SDK or our sampleapp wrapper?
laura: It looks like SDK default retry logic. Repro: run `npm run start` in sampleapp, hit wrong key, open network console.
laura: snippet from logs: ```[2026-03-22T18:12:05Z] request failed: status=401, retrying in 1s (attempt 1)\n[2026-03-22T18:12:06Z] request failed: status=401, retrying in 1s (attempt 2)``` 
pavel: That's bad. 401 should be surfaced as an AuthError (no retry) and include a `retryable: false` hint.
rachel: Agree. For parity we decided python/js should expose the same error classes: AuthError, RateLimitError, TransientError, ClientError.
sam: Current JS SDK maps 429 -> RateLimitError with `retry_after`, but 401/403 are currently thrown as generic Error in older clients.
laura: We should add a `failure_hint` field: e.g. `{ code: 'auth_invalid', retryable: false, user_hint: 'Check API key or refresh token' }` so sampleapps can show a concrete CTA.
pavel: +1. Also telemetry: add an `error_class` field for backend aggregation (AuthError/RateLimit/Transient) so we can run dashboards.
sam: Small API proposal: normalize errors to { name, status_code, code, retry_after?, message, retryable } and export typed classes in language SDKs.
rachel: For the sampleapp quick fix, change the SDK retry policy to skip on 4xx except 429. I can PR a guard in the sampleapp to avoid infinite spinner today.
laura: Thanks. Can we also update docs/snippets to show pattern:
laura: ```js
try {
  await client.generate(...)
} catch (err) {
  if (err.name === 'AuthError') showLoginModal();
  else if (err.name === 'RateLimitError') showRateLimitToast(err.retry_after);
  else retryOrFallback(err);
}
```
pavel: Edgecase: some proxies return 502 for expired token flows. We should surface original upstream body if present so error classification is correct.
sam: Good call. Add `original_status`/`raw_body` maybe truncated.
laura: I'll open a tiny RFC PR with the normalized shape + sampleapp change. Assigning @rachel to review SDK parity across py/js.
rachel: On it. Also will add a unit test that simulates 401 -> no retry and that a typed AuthError is thrown.
devex-bot: reminder: please add a changelog entry and link the sampleapp repro test to the onboarding checklist (https://redwood.company/docs/onboarding).
laura: Filed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/342 — contains repro, logs, and fix. PTAL. :sparkles:
sam: Nice. Will follow up tomorrow to ensure we land the error shape change before GA docs.
laura: thanks all :thumbsup:
